results.title: Firestop sealant, through-penetrations
results.summary: Approve with notes: confirm the items below. Assembly proof remains pending.

findings.title: VOC (air quality)
findings.detail: Package states 26 g/L; spec requires at most 250 g/L.

findings.title: Pending assembly proof
findings.detail: Product data does not establish a specific assembly's F/T ratings. Confirm the listed assembly separately.
findings.why_it_matters: Without verified F/T ratings, we can’t be sure the sealant will perform in a fire, risking smoke or flame spread through floor or wall penetrations.

findings.title: Couldn't confirm: Test standards
findings.detail: Tested in accordance with ASTM E814, ASTM E119 or UL 1479.
findings.why_it_matters: Confirming the test standard ensures the product was evaluated correctly for real-world fire conditions, which is essential for life safety.

results.title: off-topic.pdf
results.summary: Not checked: doesn't match this spec.

findings.title: Couldn't confirm: VOC (air quality)
findings.detail: VOC lower than SCAQMD 1168 requires (250 g/L: the Rule 1168 architectural sealant limit; the number comes from the rule, not the spec).
findings.why_it_matters: High VOC levels can affect indoor air quality and worker health during installation.

findings.title: Couldn't confirm: astm g21 rating
findings.detail: Firestopping materials shall have mold and mildew resistance rating of zero(0) in accordance with ASTM G21.
findings.why_it_matters: Without mold resistance, the sealant could degrade over time in damp areas, reducing its effectiveness.

findings.title: Pending assembly proof
findings.detail: Product data does not establish a specific assembly's F/T ratings. Confirm the listed assembly separately.
findings.why_it_matters: We need confirmed fire and temperature ratings to ensure the seal will perform as required in a fire event.

findings.title: Couldn't confirm: Test standards
findings.detail: Tested in accordance with ASTM E814, ASTM E119 or UL 1479.
findings.why_it_matters: Proper testing to recognized standards ensures the product will work as intended in real-world conditions.
